topic: Air Publications, their supply sources and codification systems as per INAP 100 Z – 0201
syllabus_extract: Air Publications, their supply sources and codification systems as per INAP 100 Z – 0201
specific_objectives: 1.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the policy for maintenance of naval aircraft and associated equipment, orders, instruction and procedures.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of Air Publication types and codification prefixes from sample IBs; Safety: Handle IBs with care to prevent damage; Supervision: Instructor verifies correct series identification.
intro_questions: What is the primary document governing naval aircraft maintenance policy?
Can you name one source where air publications are supplied?
Why is the codification system important for maintenance personnel?

topics: Definition and scope of Air Publications
Policy for maintenance of naval aircraft
Role of Air Publications in maintenance
development.content:
Definition and scope of Air Publications
Policy for maintenance of naval aircraft
Orders, instructions, and procedures hierarchy
Role of Air Publications in maintenance
Supply sources for Air Publications

Codification system structure and components
Interpretation of publication series codes
Identification of specific maintenance manuals
Relationship between orders and publications
Accessing publications via supply channels

Practical identification of publication types
Verification of supply source validity
Application of codification in maintenance
Review of policy implementation steps
Summary of key maintenance procedures

summary_questions: Explain the difference between an order and an instruction in the maintenance policy.
How does the codification system help in locating the correct maintenance manual?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the information from this lesson will assist in understanding Flight servicing schedules covered in LP 02.
